what: Performance Food Group distributes food. It supplies restaurants and institutions, delivers snacks and beverages to convenience stores through Vistar, and serves the convenience store channel directly.
customers: Independent and chain restaurants, convenience stores, vending operators, theatres and institutions.
money: food and supplies to restaurants and institutions
snacks and beverages to vending, theatres and retail
moat: Distribution networks serving three different channels from overlapping warehouses, which spreads fixed costs further than a single-channel distributor can.
risks: Net margin of about 1% is extremely thin
Restaurant traffic falls when consumers cut back
opportunities: Revenue grew about 7% last year and about 6% a year over three years
Analysts see about 19% upside from current levels
Independent restaurant cases, its most profitable business, grow faster than chains
watch: Independent restaurant case growth and gross profit per case.
